new: Unlike *este año* or *el año pasado*, connectors such as *ya* and *porque* don't lock you into one tense: *Ya he terminado el curso* (an open period, *ya* goes with the perfecto in Spain) but *Descansé porque terminé el curso ayer* (a finished moment). The rest of the sentence decides which tense fits.
why: "ya terminé" is not the Spain norm (ya goes with the perfecto in Spain, the unit's own rule) and *todavía* appears only with *no* + perfecto
